context_for_next_testing_agent: Audio timeline fix verified. The player.js playSlideAudio function now has two modes: (1) Timeline mode when any audio has startTime > 0 - uses setTimeout to schedule audio playback at the specified time. (2) Sequential mode when no startTime is set - plays audios one after another using 'ended' event listener. The stopAllSlideAudios function properly clears both active audios and the window.audioTimelineTimers array. All previous fixes from iterations 29 (keyboard fix) and 30 (tutor context extraction) remain intact. SCORM export produces valid packages with all fixes embedded.

bug_fix_verification.issue: Multiple audios positioned at different times in timeline played simultaneously instead of respecting startTime
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: playSlideAudio did not check for startTime positions and schedule audio playback accordingly
bug_fix_verification.fix_details: Added hasTimeline check (any audio with startTime > 0). Timeline mode: schedules each audio via setTimeout at startMs. Sequential mode: chains audios via 'ended' event when no startTime set. Also stopAllSlideAudios now clears audioTimelineTimers array.
